A1.justification: Both PDFs describe OVGGT and contain complete, readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and supplementary sections A-H. All corresponding scientific content can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction, depth-estimation, efficiency, and ablation results in Sections 4-5, plus camera-pose evaluations and supplementary analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including the main benchmark tables and supplementary camera-pose, eviction-strategy, and anchor-count experiments.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1-3.3 retain identical activation scoring, smoothing, cache compression, and Dynamic Anchor Protection procedures. Appendix C's bounded camera-head cache management is also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same reconstruction, depth, and camera-pose tasks on 7-Scenes, NRGBD, ETH3D, Long3D, Bonn, KITTI, TUM-Dynamic, and ScanNet, with unchanged scenario coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding tables and figures, including Evict3R and its budget-matched variant. Evict3R's revised bibliography entry does not establish a change to the evaluated method.

E3.justification: Sequence lengths, sampling strides, metrics, 200K/400K cache configurations, and evaluation procedures are unchanged. Appendices F-G retain the same baseline adaptations and Long3D processing and registration pipeline.

E4.justification: The cache-budget, smoothing, hybrid-scoring, and anchor ablations are identical. Appendices A, D, E, and H retain the same cache comparisons, scoring probes, failure cases, and anchor-count sensitivity analysis.

E5.justification: Both retain the same mean/median reporting. Neither introduces repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, significance tests, or other uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Numerical results, rankings, plotted trends, and qualitative examples are unchanged throughout Tables 1-7 and S1-S3 and the figures. For example, Table 1 retains 0.024 mean accuracy for OVGGT on 200-frame 7-Scenes, and Table S1 retains 0.058 ATE on 1,000-frame TUM-Dynamic.

T1.justification: Equations (1)-(9), cache-complexity reasoning, scoring definitions, and the anchor-overhead bound are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about training-free constant-cost streaming, FlashAttention compatibility, geometric accuracy, and long-sequence operation.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning redundant-cache noise, spatial coherence, and geometric anchoring are unchanged. Section 6 and Appendix E retain the same accumulated-drift limitation and proposed future refinement directions.

D1.justification: Hardware, hyperparameters, camera-head implementation details, baseline adaptations, and data-processing disclosures are unchanged. No code or data access information is added or revised.

R1.justification: The literature discussion and research positioning remain unchanged. The bibliography revision concerns the same named Evict3R method already discussed and evaluated; no substantive related-work argument or literature coverage is added.

P1.justification: The Evict3R entry changes from Deng et al., arXiv 2507.14890, reference [9], to Mahdi et al., arXiv 2509.17650, reference [17], with a different subtitle. Corresponding citations and the version/date stamp are updated. Main-text and appendix prose and structure otherwise match.

P2.justification: The revised bibliography causes limited reflow across columns and pages 10-11. Figures, table structures, plots, and their placement remain unchanged; citation numbers in some tables and captions are updated.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, supporting evidence, explanations, and limitations are unchanged. The only potentially meaningful quality benefit is the revised Evict3R attribution, but the supplied PDFs do not establish whether the new authors, title, and arXiv identifier correct the earlier entry. Its net effect on paper quality therefore remains uncertain.
